description: A ring modulator built from a model of a ring of four diodes, with the sum, difference, smaller and larger of its two diode paths brought out as well

params.text: Attenuates the In signal before the ring, 0 to 1
Sets what is passed on from the In signal: 0 lets the whole signal through, while + keeps only the part below 0V and - only the part above it, each bent by the diode curve
Attenuates the Carrier signal before the ring, 0 to 1
Sets what is passed on from the Carrier signal: 0 lets the whole signal through, while + keeps only the part below 0V and - only the part above it, each bent by the diode curve
Shifts the carrier, -5V to 5V; away from centre the In signal starts to come through the outputs on its own
Attenuates the voltage at the Offset jack before it is added to the Offset knob, 0 to 1
Sets the voltage a diode needs before it conducts at all, from almost nothing to 5V; below it the diode passes nothing
Attenuates the voltage at the Vb jack before it is added to the Vb knob, 0 to 1
Sets how far above the turn-on voltage the diode curve stays curved before it becomes a straight line, from almost nothing to 5V
Attenuates the voltage at the Vl-Vb jack before it is added to the Vl-Vb knob, 0 to 1
Sets the slope of the straight part of the diode curve, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Slope jack before it is added to the Slope knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The signal to be modulated, one per channel
The signal doing the modulating, one per channel
Modulates the carrier shift, one volt per volt scaled by the Offset CV knob
Modulates that turn-on voltage, one volt per volt scaled by the VB CV knob
Modulates that span, one volt per volt scaled by the VL-VB CV knob
Modulates the slope, one per volt scaled by the Gain CV knob

outputs.text: The ring modulated signal, the difference between the two diode paths
The carrier plus the In signal through the diode curve
The carrier minus the In signal through the diode curve
Whichever of the Sum and Diff voltages is the smaller at that moment
Whichever of the Sum and Diff voltages is the larger at that moment

notes: the two polarity switches are lettered the other way round from what they do: + passes the part of the signal below 0V and - the part above it
menu: Block DC — takes the constant offset out of all five outputs

inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
inputs.4:

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
